one_liner: Vercel has a broad REST API authenticated with self-serve access tokens that work on the free Hobby plan, and it has an official remote MCP server.
auth_notes: Access tokens are created at vercel.com/account/tokens. Sign in with Vercel offers an OAuth authorization-code flow, but it is identity-oriented; the access token is the primary method for the REST API.
access_notes: A free Hobby plan account can create an access token. The supplied pages did not re-verify this; the draft's inference is kept with lower confidence.
